messages:
Maya (CS): Quick weekly Rampcast account health for Ramptop — short version first: token usage is up, latency P95 jumped, and spend bumped. Sharing numbers + action items below.

Maya (CS): ```
Window: 2026-03-14 -> 2026-03-20
Tokens: 1,240,300 (+18% WoW, +48% QoQ)
Avg TPS: 12.2 -> 14.7 (+20%)
P50 / P95 latency: 95ms / 340ms (P95 +62% WoW)
5xx rate: 0.8% (mainly 503s vs baseline 0.12%)
Est weekly spend: $7,800 (+22% WoW)
Top routes by tokens: /chat-stream (54%), /embed (30%)
Notes: spike aligns with model variant rollover on 2026-03-16 and increased context usage from Ramp onboarding flows.
```

Jordan (AE): Thanks Maya. Do we have a spend forecast if this usage continues? Customer is mid-commit. Any quick offset (credits/commits) we can offer? :thinking:

Maya (CS): Short forecast: if current rate holds, next week ~ $9.4k. I recommend short-term credit + discuss reserved capacity. Will confirm numbers after Ravi's triage.

Ravi (SRE): I pulled deploy logs — canary deploy `deploy-2026-03-16` pushed a model variant with larger KV footprint. Observed: worker restarts and higher NFS I/O during peak. Early signal: KV cache miss rate jumped to ~38% leading to heavier disk reads.

Ravi (SRE): ```
[deploy-2026-03-16] WARN worker-gpu-7 restart-loop
OOM -> kill -> restart -> recovery on subsequent container
KV-cache-miss-rate: 38% (baseline ~5%)
NFS IOPS: x3 baseline during 11:00-13:00 UTC
503 spikes correlated to worker restart windows
```

Lena (CSE): Customer ramped context window requests (requested 32k windows for a sub-cohort) which likely forced a different quantization/runtime path. We flagged this in onboarding notes. Suggest we temporarily pin their model variant to the previous (smaller KV) profile while we stabilize.

Maya (CS): Action items: 1) @Ravi triage + mitigate 503s (revert canary if needed) — target ETA 3 hours. 2) @Product (via Lena) review runtime/quantization decision for high-context requests. 3) @Jordan reach out to customer with short note and offer 1-week credit and optional reserved-capacity trial. 4) Schedule 30-min enablement to walk best-practices for context/windowing. Also capture feedback in Zendesk CS-5237.

ops-bot: [alert] incident created -> Ramptop/high-5xx-rate (severity: medium) — start_time 2026-03-20T11:12:08Z

Jordan (AE): OK on credits offering — I'll draft an email. If we pin to older variant, what's impact on feature parity (function calls/structured output)?

Lena (CSE): Old variant preserves function-calling but has reduced support for the 32k context mode. For Ramp flows we'll keep behavior but ask them to chunk or use streaming. We can present a short runbook in the enablement session.

Ravi (SRE): Quick mitigation: rolled a hotfix to reduce cache pressure (ttl tuning) and temporarily drained problematic pods. Early signal: 5xx rate down to ~0.25% in the last 20m. Will monitor.

Maya (CS): Great. Please post monitoring link and any logs you want included in the customer note. I will ping Sam (account owner) after Ravi confirms sustained improvement.

Ravi (SRE): Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood/ramptop/d/overview (sharing perf panels). Also saved a short log excerpt.

Ravi (SRE): ```
2026-03-20T11:13:02Z INFO pod worker-gpu-7 restarted, recovery ok
2026-03-20T11:28:45Z INFO kv-cache-miss-rate: 12% after ttl tuning
2026-03-20T11:35:00Z INFO 5xx-rate: 0.25%
```

Maya (CS): I'll assign the enablement Wed 15:00 UTC. Jordan will send credit note today. Lena, please prepare a 10-slide runbook showing chunking + streaming examples. Ravi — keep monitoring and update thread when stable for 24h.

Jordan (AE): Drafted note and sent to Maya for approval. Suggest we also propose a Reserved Capacity estimate: 8–10k tokens/sec peak -> equivalent to a small committed pool.

Lena (CSE): I'll create the runbook gist and attach to the Zendesk ticket.

Maya (CS): Thanks all. Quick wins: credits live, temporary variant pin available, ttl tuning pushed. Long-term: product needs to review model selection heuristics for high-context onboarding flows.

Jordan (AE): :thumbsup:

Ravi (SRE): Monitoring will auto-update; will post a 24h summary tomorrow morning.

Maya (CS): Closing loop — if anything regresses, @ops-bot please escalate to oncall. Otherwise I'll log this in weekly health notes.
